paragraphs.chinese:
这一集继续讲全家人的夏威夷之旅。每个人对假期都有不同的期待，而且大部分人都无法按照原来的计划放松下来。

菲尔想把这趟旅行变成自己和克莱尔从未真正拥有过的蜜月。克莱尔说，带着三个孩子旅行根本不像度假，但菲尔还是说服她把孩子暂时交给米切尔和卡梅隆，两个人单独相处一会儿。

他们来到只允许成年人进入的泳池，克莱尔终于开始放松。就在这时，海莉出现了，说自己要和几个刚认识的青少年出去玩。克莱尔想阻止她，菲尔却劝妻子信任女儿，好好享受这一天。

几个小时后，亚历克斯告诉他们，海莉喝醉了，正在卫生间里呕吐。克莱尔照顾她，还警告她，酒精永远都会让她感觉这么难受。菲尔的浪漫计划看起来已经结束了，但他还准备了另一个惊喜。他安排了一场小型婚礼仪式，让自己和克莱尔终于补上多年前错过的婚礼。全家人都加入进来，见证两个人重新交换誓言。

与此同时，杰原本计划整个假期只吃东西、喝酒，什么也不做。随后，他的哥哥打来电话，提醒他，他们的父亲在六十三岁时去世，而杰现在刚好也是这个年纪。杰突然开始担心自己的健康。

他开始锻炼、游泳，还专门选择健康食品。格洛丽亚很不高兴，因为她带杰来夏威夷是为了放松，而不是让他把旅行变成健身营。杰运动得太过头，最后在爬进吊床时弄伤了后背。

菲尔发现他被困在那里，帮助他回到家人身边。杰终于告诉格洛丽亚，自己最近为什么会表现得如此反常。他不想像父亲一样太早去世。格洛丽亚理解他的担心，但也提醒他，享受生活同样重要。杰终于放松下来，点了自己原本就想吃的食物。

米切尔想参观岛上每一个有意思的地方，卡梅隆却只想坐在泳池边。卡梅隆同意和他一起观光，但明显一点也不享受，于是米切尔最后独自出发。回来后，米切尔意识到，两个人分开做各自喜欢的事其实没有问题。他们不需要用完全相同的方式度假。

不幸的是，两个人变得更放松以后，竟然把莉莉忘在了一部电梯里。格洛丽亚找到她并把她送了回来，可后来他们再次外出时，又一次把她弄丢了。

这趟假期混乱不堪，几乎没有人按照原计划行动。不过，菲尔和克莱尔终于补办了婚礼，杰找到了更好的平衡，而全家人也用另一段美好的共同回忆结束了旅行。
paragraphs.english:
This episode continues the family’s trip to Hawaii. Everyone wants a different kind of vacation, and most of them have trouble relaxing in the way they planned.

Phil wants to turn the trip into the honeymoon he and Claire never really had. Claire says that traveling with three children doesn’t feel like a vacation, but Phil convinces her to leave the kids with Mitchell and Cameron and spend some time alone with him.

They go to the adults-only pool, and Claire finally starts to relax. Then Haley appears and says she’s going out with some teenagers she just met. Claire wants to stop her, but Phil encourages her to trust Haley and enjoy the day.

A few hours later, Alex tells them that Haley is drunk and throwing up in the bathroom. Claire takes care of her and warns her that alcohol will always make her feel this terrible. Phil’s romantic plan seems to be over, but he has one more surprise. He arranges a small wedding ceremony so they can finally have the wedding they missed years ago. The whole family joins them as they renew their vows.

Meanwhile, Jay plans to spend the vacation eating, drinking, and doing nothing. Then his brother calls and reminds him that their father died at sixty-three, the same age Jay has just turned. Jay suddenly becomes worried about his health.

He starts exercising, swimming, and choosing healthy food. Gloria gets annoyed because she brought him to Hawaii to relax, not to turn the trip into a fitness camp. Jay pushes himself too hard and eventually hurts his back while getting into a hammock.

Phil finds him stuck there and helps him return to the family. Jay finally tells Gloria why he’s been acting differently. He doesn’t want to die young like his father. Gloria understands, but she also reminds him that enjoying life matters. Jay finally relaxes and orders the food he wanted in the first place.

Mitchell wants to visit every interesting place on the island, while Cameron only wants to sit by the pool. Cameron agrees to go sightseeing but clearly isn’t enjoying it, so Mitchell eventually goes alone. When Mitchell comes back, he realizes that doing things separately is fine. They don’t have to enjoy a vacation in exactly the same way.

Unfortunately, after they both become more relaxed, they accidentally leave Lily in an elevator. Gloria finds her and brings her back, but later they manage to lose her again during another trip.

The vacation is messy, and hardly anyone follows the original plan. Still, Phil and Claire finally get their wedding, Jay finds a better balance, and the family ends the trip with one more good memory together.
